batch38RestorationCheck.conclusion: 5303-to312 collapse not reproduced. Hardware state and capture timing do not explain it in this bounded test; earlier isolated sample remains unexplained. No renderer bug established or fix made.

method: Original Nogova R01WarCry.Noe; copied profiles/--nosound, synchronization validation,1920x1080/TAA100%,auto/one-bounce GI/RT sun and cloud shadows; AO/water/volumetrics off. PBR Off/auto-GI Off/auto-GI On at09:00/17:30, verified forced-CPU toggles/restoration, advancing-simulation camera translation/turns, grounded0/8/22/52/92m retreats and independent52/92m far matrices. Supplemental original interior/door and elevated roof views. Direct developer camera,not physical traversal,Steam-route or mission-completion acceptance.
variantDispositions: 31 initial exact-model regions plus3 later coating-only roof-edge regions built and rendered. Three broad blank-panel regions and two wallpaper regions withdraw after captured-CPU GI-off raster brightness patches/wedges. A separate26-region receiver trial isolates broad dusk GI color discontinuity on panel03; its three regions retain PBR/reflectors but switch reception=false and are built/rendered again in the26-region ambient trial. The final29-region runtime adds the3 coating-only edge rows and repeats focused tests,censuses,front/back/roof matrices,CPU,movement,distance,probes and performance. Roof,edge and narrow painted-frame receiver-enabled variants were not tested or represented as failures. No geometry,normal,UV,sampler,shader or lighting-gate workaround.
costMethod: RTX4060Ti/NVIDIA617.14; warm10s;GI Off/On/On/Off,settle4s/sample6s; means of paired interval medians. No builds/tests/censuses during timing. Whole-scene observations,not isolated material costs or universal budgets. Forced-CPU performance not separately timed.
limits: Source assessment completion is separate from rendering coverage. Native/CPU family counts include scenery,not per-model masks. Normal hardware T&L can contain captured CPU fallback. Independent bounded reflector endpoints do not prove reception or native vertex transformation. Near views crop taller variants; retreat views expose full silhouettes.220m front and reverse scouts in the ambient trial are terrain/shoreline-obstructed,not appearance acceptance. Far roof-edge identities have small projected area and no independent ordinary-view appearance proof. Original LOD artwork/silhouette differences remain. Not every runtime LOD or all36 placements is certified; source coverage is checked across all13 authored levels.
